cat > programs/task-a7e8cda1.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        if not row or row[0] == bg:
            continue
        color = row[0]
        i = 0
        while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
            i += 1
        if i < len(row) and all(v == bg for v in row[i:]):
            for j in range(i, len(row)):
                row[j] = 1
    return out
PY
